_comment: ANHONI seeds — CORPORATE, KARMA-TWIST FIRST (an actual STORY: setup -> planted clue -> satisfying payoff/punchline), because pure relatable-satire reads flat. Lead = Simran (curvy glam brown-suit), villain = Mr. Malhotra (khadoos). Ad-safe, Hinglish. Date-rotated.
seeds: KARMA: Manager Malhotra har badi meeting me junior Simran ka kaam apne naam kar leta hai; client presentation me Simran ne PPT ke footer me 'Prepared by: Simran' set kar rakha hai (planted clue) jo CEO ke saamne uska jhooth khol deta hai; charge Simran ko mil jaata hai.

KARMA: Malhotra ne Simran ko 'tumse na ho payega' bol ke bade project se hataya aur promotion khud le liya; Simran chup-chaap dusri jagah apply karti hai, offer aata hai; resign wale din Malhotra ko ehsaas hota hai poora client-relationship Simran ke paas tha.
KARMA: Boss ne appraisal me Simran ko '2% hike, budget nahi hai' diya; usi hafte team ko pata chalta hai boss ki nayi cabin aur Goa offsite ka bill; ek forwarded email sab expose kar deta hai.

KARMA: Jise Malhotra ne 'sirf intern' bol ke sabke saamne beizzat kiya, wo 2 saal baad usi company me Malhotra ka interviewer/reporting-manager ban ke aata hai; ek purana notebook sab yaad dila deta hai.
KARMA: Malhotra credit chura ke CEO ke saamne 'maine akele banaya' bolta hai; CEO ek technical detail poochta hai jo sirf asli banane wale Simran ko pata hai; Malhotra atak jaata hai.
KARMA: Boss meeting me Simran ka idea 'bekaar' bol ke reject karta hai; agle hafte wahi idea apne naam se present karta hai; par Simran ne wo idea pehle hi ek dated group-email me bheja tha.

KARMA: Manager ne Simran ko notice period me 'urgent handover' me phasa diya; handover doc me Simran ne har wo cheez likh di jo sirf wahi jaanti thi — ab bina uske kaam ruk jaata hai, aur company counter-offer deti hai.
KARMA: Toxic boss 'we are a family' bolta hai par leave reject karta hai; jis din wo khud chhutti pe jaata hai, ek chhoti si galti pakdi jaati hai jo dikhati hai asli kaam kaun karta tha.
RELATABLE: Din bhar back-to-back meetings, shaam ko manager 'kaam kyun nahi hua?'; aur solution ke liye kal ek aur meeting rakh deta hai.
RELATABLE: 'Bas 5 minute ka quick call' 2 ghante khinch jaata hai, aur end me 'baaki kal ke call me finalize karte hain'; sab ek email me ho sakta tha.
KARMA: Malhotra ne Simran ki design 'thodi ownership lo' bol ke le li; jab client ko wo pasand aayi to credit boss ka, jab ek bug nikla to blame Simran pe — par version-history sab bata deti hai.
KARMA: Boss ne Simran ka bonus 'performance kam thi' bol ke kaata; usi din pata chalta hai bonus-pool boss ne apne favourite ko de diya; ek leaked sheet game palat deti hai.
RELATABLE: Boss corporate-speak: 'exciting opportunity' = extra kaam bina paisa, 'we are a family' = overtime maango chhutti mat; Simran deadpan translate karti jaati hai.
KARMA: Naye joinee ko 'seekhne ka phase hai' bol ke sab kaam diya jaata hai aur credit senior leta hai; appraisal me jab senior atakta hai, junior ke saved proofs saamne aa jaate hain.

KARMA: Manager ne Simran ki chhutti 'kaam kaun karega' bol ke reject ki; jis din manager khud 10 din gayab, sab kuch smoothly chala — kyunki asli kaam Simran hi karti thi; return pe usay farak dikh jaata hai.
RELATABLE: Meeting me sab 'great point', 'let's take it offline', 'circle back' bolte hain; ek bhi decision nahi hota; Simran ki to-do list waise ki waise.
KARMA: Boss ne Simran ka presentation last-minute 'main deliver karunga' bol ke le liya; par slide-notes me Simran ke reminders the jo boss padh ke bina samjhe bol deta hai aur exposed ho jaata hai.
KARMA: Chaploos colleague boss ke saamne Simran ko neecha dikhata hai; par ek galti se reply-all hua message uski asli baat sabke saamne le aata hai.
KARMA: Boss ne raat 11 baje 'chhota urgent kaam' bhej ke subah standup me 'kal kya kiya?' poocha; Simran ke paas timestamps the — poori team ke saamne sach nikal aata hai.
RELATABLE: Salary aane ke agle din 'cost-cutting' ka mail, par boss ki nayi cabin aur offsite; Simran ka reaction hi poori kahani keh deta hai.
